texts: bad: "the water of the Sunken Cove" is asked for as water *contained in* the cove, but an "of"-phrase like this is stored as a part-of/belongs-to link instead, so the question looks for a connection no statement of that same phrase would have recorded and can come back empty even when the fact is in the knowledge base. Rewrite as "Why did a wraith emerge from the water in the Sunken Cove on day 120 of Year 1?" — the explicit "in" states the containment the question is already asking about, so statement and question agree. One residual caveat, harmless here: "day 120 of Year 1" names no month, so the day number is filed in the ordinary calendar-day slot — the same on both sides, so it still matches.
